description: Discover and quote a real POST-only merchant API that validates JSON input BEFORE returning an x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED response. Machine-readable instructions for externally operated, buyer-controlled agents. This is NOT an invoice, payment, settlement, seller-authentication proof, or auto-execution command.
economic_owner: Same one beneficial human owner as PaperPilot Tools VM1 and original VM5 paid merchant; original software AI-assisted

buyer_offer.display_name: Customer-provided CSV structural QA report, paid HTTP POST
buyer_offer.result_if_paid: Machine-readable issues: row and column counts, duplicates, empty cells, type anomalies and formula-like cells. No raw customer data echoed.
buyer_offer.scope_limits: No tax, GDPR, data correctness or merchant-account certification. Do not submit private identities, keys, regulated records, or sensitive production data.

discovery_problem: An unsigned GET or HEAD to this POST-only route returns HTTP 404 and an unsigned POST with malformed or empty JSON returns HTTP 400. A search crawler using only HEAD/GET/OPTIONS or POST {} can mistakenly conclude that no x402 paywall exists. A valid, entirely fictional CSV POST reaches the unpaid 402 quote.

free_buyer_safe_quote_probe.intent: Public unpaid x402 quote inspection only; no payment authorized
free_buyer_safe_quote_probe.note: Only the current live 402 quote controls later buyer decisions; prices and receiver must be checked again before separate buyer-authorized payment. Do not interpret a 402, browser CORS success, or this public spec as delivered paid work.

independent_third_party_original_402_ver.verifier: Independent x402 community contributor, no purchase or wallet signing
independent_third_party_original_402_ver.claim_verified: Valid synthetic JSON POST reached correct native Circle Base USDC HTTP402 quote; browser CORS OPTIONS allowed required request headers
independent_third_party_original_402_ver.does_not_verify: Real paid 200 response, repeat buyers, paid buyer-owned POST checkout, merchant business history or settlement

what_not_to_do: Do not issue wallet signature unless an independent buyer explicitly authorizes the exact current chain, token, amount and payTo.
Do not send a MetaMask seed/private key, bearer credential or funds as a required registration/deposit.
Do not confuse an original seller testing its own route, a crawler probe or a public listing with an independent paying customer.
